Eli K: quick question about surfacing SLO notify policies in the console. product wants a single-line summary + the last override reason. thoughts on API shape?
Sam R: my strong preference: server returns a canonical `notify_status` blob so console doesn't re-evaluate rules client-side. avoids drift during rollout.
Nora V: agree. suggested fields: computed_sensitivity (low/med/high), active_override(actor,expires), last_action_reason, and a tiny cost_badge -> last_1h_est (number+currency). keep it low-cardinality.
Eli K: UX note: show the sensitivity badge, small timestamp for last change, and a "why" tooltip that expands explain_chain (max 3 items). teams want to see fallback reasons when runtime soft-snoozes.
Sam R: runtime will emit a compact notify-eval event. propose the API include explain_chain as a short list of strings (tier->override->fallback) capped to 3 to keep payload small.
Nora V: security: actor should be handle/id only, never email. strip route names that may contain customer-identifying strings.
eng-bot: synthetic-alert: sandbox-9 SLO eval at 3950012360 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Eli K: override UX: product wants a "Temporarily reduce alerts" button calling POST /v1/tenants/:id/overrides with TTL. we need guardrails: non-admin max 6h, admin max 7d, all writes audited.
Sam R: server must validate TTL, auth, and rate-limit overrides per-tenant to prevent abuse. also produce immutable audit entries accessible from the SLO card.
Nora V: rollout plan: stage1 surface read-only notify_status; stage2 enable overrides for sandboxes; stage3 gated prod overrides with admin gate + longer audit retention.
Eli K: I'll draft the OpenAPI for GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-status and POST /v1/tenants/:id/overrides with sample responses (include explain_chain). assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform, label `slo-notify-surface`, ETA 2 sprints.
Sam R: QA will run a canary that synthesizes backpressure, verify explain_chain contains fallback reason, and cost_badge within 5% of billing snapshot.
Nora V: one more: console should display the last_applied_reason string prominently so product teams understand why a page didn't fire.
Eli K: thanks all — will create the ticket and mockups, review API Thursday.
